description: This file implements a database-backed configuration store for Mattermost, including functions for creating, loading, saving, and managing configuration data and files, with support for migrations and database connection handling.

classes.name: DatabaseStore
classes.description: A struct that manages database connection and configuration persistence for Mattermost.

methods.name: NewDatabaseStore
methods.description: Creates a new DatabaseStore instance, initializes database connection and configuration tables.

methods.name: initializeConfigurationsTable
methods.description: Ensures migration tables are set up and applies all migrations.

methods.name: parseDSN
methods.description: Parses and validates PostgreSQL DSN URLs.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Replaces current configuration in the database.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Serializes and saves configuration data to the database, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the active configuration from the database, or defaults if none exists.

methods.name: GetFile
methods.description: Retrieves a persisted configuration file by name.

methods.name: SetFile
methods.description: Stores or updates a configuration file.

methods.name: HasFile
methods.description: Checks if a configuration file exists.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a sanitized string representation of the database connection.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Removes old configuration entries from the database.
